correctness.rationale: Derivations of T_n(K) are inner, unique modulo scalar matrices, by Peirce-component multiplications. Composition-idempotent ad_H is semisimple, so the nilpotent part in its commuting Jordan decomposition vanishes modulo the scalar center; upper unitriangular diagonalization then gives λ_i−λ_j∈{0,1} for i<j. With λ_1=0 odd characteristic forces one 0-to−1 cut; characteristic two permits any binary label string. A labeling with k opposite entries has c=k(n−k) unequal ordered pairs, orbit size q^c and derivation rank c. This yields the displayed parity-dependent rank enumerators. Independently enumerated upper triangular generators modulo scalars and checked D²=D plus rank distributions: (n,q)=(3,2) gives 1+12t², (3,3) 1+18t², (4,2) 1+32t³+48t⁴, matching formulas.
